context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 不全/悪循環/転移/結核/抗生/天文学/否認/思い知らさ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、機能不全の組織、警察、本気で、是正、進めております、絶対、本当に、感謝、いただきたいです。
lines.en: We're actively working to address systemic issues within the organization. We'd truly appreciate your understanding.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Steady pace with careful emphasis on 「本気で」. Composed posture — this is official but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者組織、犯罪の悪循環、本当に、深刻ですね、警察、対策、急務ですよね、本気で、絶対に。
lines.en: The cycle of crime within these suspect organizations is genuinely serious. Police countermeasures really are urgent, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, engaged tone. Slight rise at the end seeking confirmation. Leaning forward slightly — genuine curiosity, not performing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。組織犯罪の手口、海外に、転移している、と、本気で、報道ありました、本当に、絶対、警戒。
lines.en: Yes. We've seen reports indicating that organized crime methods are beginning to operate overseas. We're staying alert.
lines.style: Factual, informative delivery. Even cadence — sharing information without drama. Slight emphasis on the risk but professional restraint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔の結核患者の人権侵害、警察、本気で、過去、反省してきたんですよね、本当に、立派です、絶対。
lines.en: The way the police have genuinely reflected on past human rights violations — like with TB patients — that's really commendable.
lines.style: Sincere, almost surprised tone. Slower pace emphasizing the past reflection. Quiet admiration underneath — not performative praise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、抗生物質の不正流通、関わっている疑い、本当に、深い、調べております、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The suspect appears to be involved in illegal antibiotic distribution. We're conducting a thorough investigation.
lines.style: Steady, procedural delivery. Clipped but not rushed. Professional distance — focusing on facts, not emotion. Light pause before each new clause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、最新の天文学的データ、衛星映像も、活用しているんですよね、本気で、すごい時代ですね、絶対に。
lines.en: It's remarkable how the police are utilizing modern tools — satellite imagery and the latest data analysis. We really are living in an incredible era.
lines.style: Warm appreciation with genuine wonder. Slight acceleration on 「すごい時代」. Open, almost childlike curiosity about the technology — not cynical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、否認し続けておりますが、警察、絶対、真相、明らかにしてまいります、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The suspect continues to deny involvement, but we will get to the truth. We won't stop until we do.
lines.style: Firm resolve with quiet conviction. Emphasis on 「絶対」 as a personal commitment, not a shout. Steady eye-contact level. Calm but unwavering.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察活動の難しさ、本当に、報道で、思い知らされます、本気で、感謝、絶対、しております、いつも、本当に。
lines.en: I'm constantly struck by how challenging police work really is. Reading about it, I'm genuinely grateful — for everything officers do.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere closing. Soft, reflective pace. Trailing off slightly on 「いつも、本当に」 — genuine gratitude, not performative. A moment of real feeling.
